subs.text: Gabby — your name, your photos, your coaching. Already built into a working platform.
A home for Get Fit Gabby — coaching, race tools and community, together.
The Zones — station preparation, running and race-day planning.
Your story and your race imagery give the platform its personality.
Free tools give people a reason to visit. Coaching has a clear next step when they are ready.
Events and race planning sit alongside the coaching, all under your name.
The Warriors Wall — a home for community race photos. The demo entries show the layout.
Ask Gabby — training and race questions have a dedicated home.
Your coaching page brings the offer and the application route together, with links to your existing setup.
Find a race-mate — a place to find doubles, mixed and relay partners.
A useful community feature between race weekends, not another comment thread to search.
Race Tools: the predictor helps athletes explore a target finish time.
Practical tools give people a reason to keep returning to your platform.
Split analyser — a place to break down a race and look for improvement opportunities.
Something useful to bring into a coaching conversation about the next race.
Results board — a home for times and progress. The demo shows the structure ready to populate.
Station prep — technique, pacing and coaching cues for all eight stations.
Your race photos bring the guides to life alongside advice athletes can revisit.
Run Zone — pacing and compromised running, the work between the stations.
Taper Zone — a clear guide to the final week before race day.
Race calendar — somewhere to plan the event and the trip around it.
Race crew meetups — space for the community around your coaching to organise race day together.
News and updates under your own name, ready for coaching notes and race recaps.
Your current destinations together: lululemon, Marchon and your Get Fit Gabby links.
The Marchon button takes visitors straight to their site — a working onward link.
lululemon has its own route too, and your Linktree remains available. No codes or commission are assumed.
One branded starting point for the coaching, kit and community destinations people already look for.
Join the list — a direct way to stay in touch with people interested in your coaching.
And behind the public pages: the Desk.
Coaching income, race costs and partner activity in one dashboard. These figures are demo data.
A place to review the business side alongside the athlete-facing platform.
Your coaching, useful race tools and your community — all under Get Fit Gabby.
Have a look around, Gabby. I'd love to hear what you think.
